versions.content: ModeRequestTypeMap Another mapping class, Mod- eRequestTypeMap , has been introduced in order to allow the transport of mode re- lated information via normal sender-receiver communication. Apart from this, mode information is not handled by the usual type system but needs special meta-classes.
